description: This file implements a NetworkManager client class for managing network interfaces, IP configurations, hostname settings, and connection priorities. It interacts with D-Bus to query and update network settings, manage interface states, and retrieve network information, specifically tailored for a GNOME-based Linux environment.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A class providing an interface to interact with NetworkManager via D-Bus, allowing configuration of network interfaces, IP settings, hostname, and connection prioritization.
